title: Nat Kobitz confirms being read into a UAP program

tellings.quote: Have you ever been read in to any kind of program involving unidentified aerial phenomena, alien technology?

plain: Ross Coulthart, an Australian journalist who investigates UFO claims, says that sometime around 2018 to 2020 he put a direct question to a man named Nat Kobitz. He asked whether Kobitz had ever been "read in", meaning given secret clearance and briefed, on any programme involving unidentified aerial phenomena (the government's term for UFOs) or alien technology. Coulthart says Kobitz confirmed that he had, which would mean such a secret programme exists.
